lines.text: AI writes more code than your team can review. Agents and IDEs ship all day. And alerts struggle to keep up.
Speed without a governed loop is how agent-driven change becomes the next incident on your watch.
Meet Aiden OS. The Agentic OS for DevOps. Build, govern, observe, and remediate production, with guardrails baked in.
Four persona agents. One shared memory. InfraOps, DevOps, Observability, and SRE.
Aiden for InfraOps turns intent into policy-checked change. Ten times the velocity. Every deploy checked.
Aiden for DevOps triages the ticket queue. Every execution reviewed before it runs.
Aiden for Observability correlates the signal. Ninety percent less alert noise.
And Aiden for SRE finds root cause and remediates inside policy. Fifty percent lower MTTR. You keep the call.
All four share one Operational Context Graph. What one domain learns, every domain acts on.
Every action inside policy. Bounded autonomy that scales at the pace of your confidence.
Aiden OS. Outcomes, not agents. Schedule a demo at stackgen.com.
